# AI Engineer Pulse

> Daily AI industry intelligence curated for AI Engineers and Startup Founders — tech news, research, business trends, and startup funding, refreshed every 24 hours.

AI Engineer Pulse (https://aibuildpulse.vercel.app/) is an automated news dashboard built for two distinct personas: AI Engineers (ML practitioners and technical builders) and Founders (startup creators and business builders). It collects, filters, and categorizes news on a 24-hour cycle.

Users can toggle between "AI Engineer" (focusing on LLMs, RAG, infrastructure) and "Founder" (focusing on YC, Stripe, TechCrunch, and Indie Hackers) to get tailored AI-generated summaries.

- Publisher: amarachinthaakhil — https://www.linkedin.com/in/amarachinthaakhil
- Site language: en-IN
- Category: NewsApplication, AI industry intelligence & startup trends
- Price: Free (USD 0)
- Update cadence: automated GitHub Action, daily at midnight IST
- Push Notifications: 6 automated news alerts per day (via Firebase)
- Backend: Supabase (auth + data)

## Core Views

- [Today's Overview](https://aibuildpulse.vercel.app/today): Fresh stories from the last 24 hours. Default landing view. Supports persona toggling (Engineer/Founder), full-text search, and category filtering.
- [Weekly Overview](https://aibuildpulse.vercel.app/weekly): The last 7 days of news rolled up.
- [Briefing](https://aibuildpulse.vercel.app/briefy): A condensed, narrative digest of the day's most important items.
- [Research](https://aibuildpulse.vercel.app/research): Research papers and technical publications relevant to practitioners.
- [Tools](https://aibuildpulse.vercel.app/tools): New and notable AI tooling, frameworks, and SDKs.
- [Trends](https://aibuildpulse.vercel.app/trends): Visualizations showing which tech topics are gaining momentum.
- [Reading List](https://aibuildpulse.vercel.app/reading): A saved-items list for signed-in users.

## Sources

**AI Engineer:**
- OpenAI News (Models, APIs, Research)
- Google DeepMind (Research, New Models)
- Hugging Face (Open models, AI tools)
- arXiv (AI/ML Research Papers)
- NVIDIA (GPU, Infrastructure)
- Anthropic (via Google News)

**Founder:**
- Y Combinator (Startups, Fundraising)
- Stripe (Payments, SaaS Business)
- TechCrunch Startups (Funding, Startup News)
- Indie Hackers (Founder Stories, Growth)

## Facts

- Article pages feature a detailed breakdown: "What happened?", "Why is it important?" (split for Engineers and Founders), "Technical Details", "Business Impact", and personal Notes.
- Data refresh: automated pipeline runs every 24 hours.
- Built-in chatbot: answers questions about the site's features and searches the day's news.
- Frontend is a single-page static app (HTML/CSS/JS) with Supabase for auth and Firebase for notifications.
